# GitHub visual assets

- `ase-hero.png` — repository hero/banner.
- `ase-architecture.svg` — end-to-end production architecture.
- `ase-discovery-static-ip.svg` — source discovery and DNS-derived direct-IP flow.
- `ase-verification-multiclient.svg` — verification and compatible core runtime routing.
- `ase-operator-probe-topology.svg` — authenticated self-hosted operator probe topology and evidence boundary.
- `ase-scoring-feed-publish.svg` — contextual scoring, feed selection and atomic publication.

All diagrams intentionally describe architecture/evidence semantics rather than claiming current operator or GUI validation.
